register.labelZh: DATE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: date back 可以表示一項習俗、慶典或活動在多年前開始,並一直延續至今。；date back to 可以把傳統、組織、名稱或關係與其開始的時間連繫起來。；date from 適合用來說明舊花瓶、硬幣、書信、照片或畫作製於哪個年代。；這些表達經常出現在博物館、旅遊指南、歷史書籍,以及古老地方和物件的介紹中。
register.summaryEn: Date back can show that a custom, celebration or activity began many years ago and has continued into the present. Date back to can connect a tradition, organisation, name or relationship to the time when it began. Date from is useful when discussing when an old vase, coin, letter, photograph or painting was made. These expressions often appear in museums, travel guides, history books and descriptions of old places and objects.
